Appearance.ShowTrayIcon: Show an icon in the notification area
Appearance.Hint: Widgets sit on the wallpaper, below every ordinary window. Win+D or the taskbar's "Show desktop" will not hide them.

Startup.Hint: Registers under the current user's startup items, so no administrator rights are needed, and it can be turned off at any time from the Startup tab in Task Manager.

Notice.Title: DeskKit cannot save right now
Notice.Unavailable: The database could not be opened, so nothing was loaded and nothing will be saved. Close whatever is holding it, then restart DeskKit.
Notice.NewerSchema: The database was written by a newer version of DeskKit. It was left exactly as it is, so DeskKit is closing rather than showing a layout it cannot keep. Upgrade DeskKit to use it.
Notice.DataProblem: Some of the stored data could not be read. What could not be read was left alone; the log names it.
